description: CHARACTERIZATION FIXTURE for saga #811 (issue #816): this locks TODAY'S DEFECTIVE behaviour at the `execute()` stage, not the correct behaviour, and must be FLIPPED to the correct expectation now that the #814 `[spec]` ruling has merged and #815 implements it. The wall was built before the ruling because this defect emits neither a diagnostic nor a crash, so a fixture that merely runs the program passes against the broken build. Fault shape A — an UNRESOLVABLE NAME in argument position. `check()` computes the right answer (`ol-unknown-command`, whose usual stage is `semantic` per spec/error-model.md:97) and `execute()` never consults it, so the statement is discarded whole with no diagnostic and no effect. The clearest single statement of the defect in this corpus: the run produces `print` events for 1 and 3 and none for the middle statement, while reporting zero diagnostics — the program silently does two thirds of what it says. The middle statement still emits its `instruction` marker, so the discard happens after the statement is entered, not before.
